forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {擦|こす}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To move something back and forth against a surface with pressure.
To brush or scrape lightly against something while passing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}って⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけません→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。

examples.english: I scraped my foot against a rock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}って⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とした→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: I scrubbed the pot to remove the stains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}って⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧？
⟦マッチ→マッチ：02966_macchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}って⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I struck a match to light a fire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電柱|でんちゅう}→電柱：17913_denchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}った。
examples.english: I scraped the car against a utility pole.
I scraped my arm on the door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}って⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I scraped my shoes against a rock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{擦|こす}らないで。
examples.english: Don't scrub your skin too hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ミラー→ミラー：25746_miraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}った。
examples.english: I scraped the car's side mirror on a narrow road.

notes:
{擦|こす}る is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to rub or scrub with friction.

INTRANSITIVE: ⟦{擦|こす}れる→擦れる：28426_kosureru⟧ (to rub against, to become worn)

ASPECT (ている):
{擦|こす}っている indicates the rubbing action is ongoing.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [body part]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}る — to rub [body part]
- [object]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[surface]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{擦|こす}る — to scrape [object] against [surface]
- [thing]⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{擦|こす}る — to scrub with [thing]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}る (rub one's eyes)
- ⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}る (scrub one's back)
- ⟦マッチ→マッチ：02966_macchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}る (strike a match)
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|こす}る (scrape a car)

OFTEN IN HIRAGANA:
This verb is frequently written as こする.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{揉|も}む→揉む：00289_momu⟧: to knead, massage (more pressing)
- {擦|こす}る: to rub, scrub (more friction)
- ⟦{撫|な}でる→撫でる：04411_naderu⟧: to stroke (gentle, one direction)
